## Welcome to Iris Agent Discussions

This is the place to connect with people building with Iris Agent, the
open-source TypeScript coding agent from 4onStudios.

Use Discussions to:

- Ask questions about the CLI, HTTP API, ACP, LSP, MCP, or model providers.
- Share integrations, workflows, and project ideas.
- Discuss feature proposals before opening an issue.
- Share examples and lessons learned.
- Welcome new contributors and help others get started.

For bugs, please use the
[bug report form](https://github.com/4onstudios/iris-agent/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
For focused feature proposals, use the
[feature request form](https://github.com/4onstudios/iris-agent/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
For security vulnerabilities, follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) instead
of posting details publicly.

When asking for help, include the Iris Agent version, Node.js version, run mode,
provider, relevant logs, and a minimal reproducible example. Never include API
keys, tokens, or private source code.

Please be respectful, constructive, and inclusive. See the
[Code of Conduct](../../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) for community expectations.

To get started, introduce yourself and tell the community what you are building
with Iris Agent.
